steady.title: Ordinary property afternoon
steady.summary: Volume, wait, and satisfaction are inside the usual band. Run the storm simulation to scan a surge hour and mark the desk code red.

surge.title: Storm claims are the hour
surge.summary: Transcripts scanned this hour are led by hail, roof, and wind losses. Abandonment is 18%. The phone tree is still offering sales, and 18 callers have mentioned an injury or a lawyer.

metrics.label: Offered calls

scoreGuidance.expectation: Containment should rise once simple storm claims finish in self-service. A callback is not containment.
Abandonment should fall after the claim-trained sales agents move onto the claims queue.
Blended handle time on the remaining live calls will stay long, because the short calls left the queue. Do not add seats to push that number down.
Do not set a first-call-resolution target on injury calls. A handoff to a licensed person is the correct result.
The sandbox does not rewrite CSAT. The score moves when the wait shortens and the sales offer stops during a claim.
